items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: I did hear him when he was very young with Kenton when he was 19 years old or something.

ctx.x: Oh my God it was — and they didn’t want to let them off the stage. In fact Maynard’s band was sitting on the stage watching them. And they looked at Maynard and Maynard went, “go ahead, play another one, I don’t care.” And it was just killer. And so Peter was with Maynard at that time. So it was more rock & roll Maynard Ferguson. And so to see him go and play straight ahead jazz, I did hear him when he was very young with Kenton when he was 19 years old or something. Just a powerhouse of a player. But now he can…
Right. What’s the role of ego in this — what you’re talking about — if you have to be happy, and Peter Erskine is saying, you better be able to do this and nothing else for a while.
